liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Broken Arrow** (2 reviews): Broken Arrow was raw, but Phil singing lead made it a great night; Reviewer says this was one of the earliest Broken Arrows [12][20]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Bruce Hornsby's accordion fit well in China Cat, and the China>Rider pairing was very nice [9]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): A superb Estimated Prophet and its segue jam led into an unexpected Terrapin [9]
- **Wave To The Wind** (1 review): Wave had good jamming potential, though the awkward vocals were hard to get past [9]
- **Corinna** (1 review): Reviewer says Corrina is always a killer live [12]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Reviewer loves the accordion sounds on I Know You Rider [17]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Reviewer found The Music Never Stopped smoking hot in the first set [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd93-03-18 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd93-03-18 t02 Hell In A Bucket**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd93-03-18 t03 Sugaree**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd93-03-18 t04 Walkin' Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd93-03-18 t05 Broken Arrow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd93-03-18 t06 Loose Lucy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd93-03-18 t07 When I Paint My Masterpiece**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd93-03-18 t08 Friend Of The Devil**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-03-18.139673.fob.schoeps.wise.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 175 min [1]
- **gd1993-03-18.dsbd.miller.79070.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 3/5 by 9 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds excellent, though Jerry's vocals sometimes dip low, perhaps from him pulling away from the mic; Soundboard has very nice sound quality for a 90s show; Reviewer calls the soundboard beautiful [17][19][20]
- **gd93-03-18.ST250.ladner.16814.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 176 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [4]. Said about its sound: Described as a great audience tape; Audience recording has loud crowd noise and taper issues; reviewer suggests seeking the Schoeps source instead [12][15]
- **gd1993-03-18.167441.nak304.barnum.miller.flac2496**: source not stated; 21 songs; 174 min [7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer drove from Philly; it was freezing in the parking lot, but the arena inside heated up [10]
- Reviewer attended this as their first concert ever [11]
- Reviewer's tickets were not waiting at Will Call, so they missed the show [13]
- Reviewer complains Weir stopped playing his part, leaving it to two or three keyboard players [18]
- Bruce Hornsby played accordion for the entire second set and the encore [1]
- Barnum taped many Northeast shows from the early 1980s until his death in 2017; about 60 masters surfaced in a Hudson, NY record store [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-03-18.139673.fob.schoeps.wise.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Jim Wise and Scott Clugston; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Jim Wise's FOB Audience DAT > Schoeps CMC6/MK4 (hand-held ORTF) > Sonosax SX-M2 > Dat (Sony D10 Pro/48k); Transfer Info: DAT Master… [1]
- **gd1993-03-18.dsbd.miller.79070.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat (44.1k) D [3]
- **gd93-03-18.ST250.ladner.16814.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by D. Duquette and Chris L.; source: Audience: Soundfield ST250's [4]. Also: Reviewer says the mic setup is good and expensive, but placement matters; front-of-board positions suit only calm crowds [15]
- **gd1993-03-18.167441.nak304.barnum.miller.flac2496**: taped by Bruce Barnum; transferred by Charlie Miller, Mark Goldey; source: Nak 300 Shotguns > TC-D3 > D5 [7]. Also: Audience recording by Bruce Barnum, pitch-corrected and patched with tape flips from the soundboard, SHNID 79070 [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1993-03-18 Capital Centre, Landover, MD, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-03-18-capitol-centre-landover-md-usa/) [22]
